title: Book
description: Top-level narrative artifact composed under a profile stack. Validity requires word count within tolerance, all scenes committed, Promise Ledger zero overdue, and Sensitivity Profile compliance verified.

seed_value.description: RNG seed pinned at run start. Same seed + same inputs = bit-identical outputs.

genre.description: Primary genre identifier (e.g. romance, thriller). Resolved from genre_profile.

heat_level.description: Heat level ceiling for this book; must not exceed sensitivity_profile ceiling.

word_count_target.description: Total target word count for the finished manuscript.

act_structure.description: Structural template governing chapter/scene slot allocation.

chapters.description: Ordered list of chapter IDs. Chapters are separately schema-validated.

profile_refs.description: IDs of the resolved profile pentad used for this book.

concept_seed.description: Human-authored high-level concept (the spec intake premise). Stub — expand during Phase 6 implementation.

series_position.description: Position within series (1 = standalone or book 1). Stub — expand during Phase 9 implementation.

state_refs.description: References to runtime state artifacts for this book. Stub — expand during Phase 6 implementation.
